observations.statement: Background is a soft mint green gradient (lighter at top); panels are cream; the accent is a saturated coral used on the play button and star icons.
observations.evidence: full-bleed background; level cards; play button; star rating icons

observations.statement: Level cards and the HUD panel have corners rounded to roughly 25-30% of their height (xl class); no element is a full pill.
observations.evidence: 3x3 grid of level cards; HUD panel top-left

observations.statement: All cards and panels carry a dark brown outline of consistent width, around 2% of the element height.
observations.evidence: level cards, HUD panel, play button

observations.statement: Mascot is a chibi-proportion animal (head roughly 50% of total height) with flat colour fills, a single soft cel shadow under the chin, and the same dark brown outline as the UI panels.
observations.evidence: mascot at bottom-left of the frame

observations.statement: Level numbers and the title are a heavy rounded sans in Title Case with a dark outline and a one-pixel-class drop shadow.
observations.evidence: title at top centre; numbers on level cards

observations.statement: Per the user's description: the popup is a cream panel with a decorative ribbon header, three stars above a score line, and two stacked buttons (Next in green, Retry in grey); the panel corners are described as 'slightly rounded, not very round'.
Per the user's description: popup buttons are 'full pill shaped' with a thick dark outline and a solid darker bottom edge; labels are 'all caps'.
Per the user's description: the popup is centred, occupies about 80% of the width, and the gameplay behind is dimmed with a dark overlay.
Popup panel radius described as 'slightly rounded' is read as md class; this contradicts the xl class observed on home-screen panels.
observations.evidence: ref-1 level cards vs ref-2 user description of panel corners

observations.statement: Label case differs: Title Case on the home screen (viewed) versus all caps on popup buttons (described).
observations.evidence: ref-1 title and level numbers vs ref-2 user description of button labels

observations.statement: Whether popup buttons have the same top highlight band as home-screen buttons is not stated in the description.
observations.evidence: n/a — user description does not mention highlights

observations.statement: Popup entrance animation is not derivable from a static image or a written description of a still frame.

rules.statement: Mint background, cream surfaces, coral accent reserved for primary action and reward icons; dark brown as the universal outline colour.
Panels and cards use the xl radius class; this applies to popup panels as well because ref-1 owns the shapes role.
Pill silhouette, thick dark outline, solid darker bottom edge; green for the advancing action, grey for the secondary action.
Centred cream panel at ~80% width over a dark dimming overlay, decorative ribbon header, reward row (stars) above the result line, stacked buttons.
Chibi-proportion mascot with flat fills, one soft cel shadow, and the same outline colour and width class as UI panels.
HUD lives in an xl-radius outlined panel at top-left, matching card styling.

conflicts.resolution: ref-1 wins (role shapes): xl class globally. ref-2 md value recorded; ask the user whether popup panels should intentionally differ before adding a context:popup exception.
No reference owns the typography role. Title Case (ref-1) vs all caps (ref-2) is unresolved; the user must assign the typography role or state that button labels are intentionally uppercase.
